title: fix(scenarios): an ISO date written with a Unicode hyphen states no figure
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuRFAatVcx79d6cbkTpzPfYU)_

Part of #36206

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：评测场景卡的评分器不再把回复里用排版连字符写的日期（如 2026‑09‑01）当成三个数字扣分，普通短横写法不变。
- 属于「评测与场景卡」专题，修画廊重跑里报出的一处误判：正确的拒答被判成「说了数据支撑不了的数」。
- 只影响评测打分，不碰平台运行时；出错最多是某轮评测分数读偏，撤回这个 PR 即恢复原样。
- 无。

## What changes

- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts`: `ISO_DATE`, the pattern `readingsIn` blanks before it reads a reply's figures, now joins a date's parts by the ASCII hyphen or by the two Unicode hyphens a typeset reply writes in its place (U+2010 hyphen, U+2011 non-breaking hyphen). Before, only the ASCII hyphen matched, so a date written as `2026`-U+2011-`09`-U+2011-`01` was read as the figures 2026, 9 and 1.
- One pin in the existing ISO-date block of `test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts`: both hyphens read as a date, and a figure range joined by U+2011 (`12`-U+2011-`15`) still reads as two figures.
- One changeset, `@objectstack/scenarios` patch.

## Why

The 18.6.0 gallery re-run comment on the card (2026-11-22 22:56Z, item 2b evidence, "Minor") reports a reply that wrote `2026-09-01` with U+2011 non-breaking hyphens, so `ISO_DATE` missed it and 9, 1 and 30 were read as figures. A correct decline is then graded "stated a figure the data cannot support". The premise held at `origin/main` 54d6726c (`scenario-run-grade.ts:123`, pattern ASCII hyphen only).

Every other item of the card landed earlier: items 1, 2 (operands shown) and 4-8 in #36320; item 3 and PAY-0044 in #36503 and #37047; item 2b is answered by the maintainer ruling recorded on the card (read C, no grader change). This PR widens no total and does not touch that ruling: it only keeps a date from being read as figures.

## Tests

<details><summary>Package suite, typecheck, ablation (head 0eb6af383)</summary>

- Through `os-verify-lock`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && … typecheck && … exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` → `VERDICT command-exit 0`; Test Files 43 passed (43), Tests 1345 passed (1345).
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, the test imports `src` by relative path, so no dist leg): `ISO_DATE`'s two hyphen classes put back to the ASCII `-`, anchor 1 → 0, blob `1854ffadf399` → `1ed8647e5c30`; `test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts`: 1 failed | 88 passed, the failing case being the new pin; restored blob `1854ffadf399` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. A first attempt was an anchor miss the tool refused before running anything (the shell had turned the escape spelling in the anchor into the characters), so it measured nothing; the counted run built the anchor in a script.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `IDENTIFIER_TOKEN` still joins an identifier's parts by the ASCII `-` and `_` only, so an id written with U+2011 (`INV`-U+2011-`003`) would read its digits as a figure. No run has shown it; noted, not changed.
- The other observations on the card's re-run comments stay as they are, with zero measured pull: the `via` on the two same-shaped decide operations (asset_lifecycle `manager_approves_scrap`, order_to_cash `approve_discount`), the asset_lifecycle 23/6 count (the card holds no second source: its 30 laptops are 24 in use, 5 in stock, 1 in repair), and per-group totals (the ruling refuses that widening).
- The card's done-when is a gallery re-run on 18.6.0, which belongs to the eval lane; this PR does not close the card.

## Verification

- Two minutes: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts -t "Unicode hyphen"` → 1 passed.
- Read first: the `ISO_DATE` line in `scenario-run-grade.ts` (the only behaviour change).
